summary: Checkbox control: a styled boolean toggle exposing checked as a level and onChange as an edge.
description: The Checkbox control renders a toggle with full style/state theming. `checked` is both an input (set programmatically) and an output level holding the current value; `onChange` fires on each user toggle. Interaction state (`hoverState`, `pressedState`, `focusState`) and `enabled` behave as on the other controls, with per-visual-state styling ports.
whenToUse: Boolean choices the user flips directly: settings, consent, done flags. For one-of-many choices use Radio Buttons in a Radio Button Group; for an on/off in logic without UI, use a Switch node.

ports.checked: Boolean level, input and output — bind data in, read the current value out.
ports.onChange: Signal; a user toggle happened (fires after `checked` updated). Trigger persistence here.
ports.enabled: Boolean level; false shows the disabled state and blocks interaction.

runtimeBehavior: Declared-port-groups: label ports appear when the label is enabled, and each visual state (hover, pressed, disabled, focused) adds state-scoped styling ports. The catalog list is the superset the editor filters by current parameters.
patterns: `checked` → Set Object Properties value + `onChange` → its `store`: level carries the data, edge commits it.
